arStrings.szText:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Forming or consuming a Corpse reduces the Essence costs and Cooldowns of your {c_important}Profane{/c} and {c_important}Macabre{/c} Skills by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]%{/c} and increases their damage by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} Your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills form {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} Corpses over their duration.
